title: Gravitational Wave-Inspired Scrambling Delay in Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Wormhole Teleportation
summary: In the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model, traversable wormhole teleportation fidelity probes the many-body scrambling of holographic black holes. We apply a gravitational-wave-inspired periodic Floquet deformation derived from the lowest-dimensional bilinear $\text{SYK}_4$ sector to the boundary, thereby characterizing the channel response via exact numerical time evolution at $βJ = 2$.
